name: search-open-product
description: Category (c)/live-finding fix regression: search_help's cta.kind must be candidate-count-aware (prompts/decide.md 'Failed search' recipe) — re-running a store's own search with a full product name as the query can match on generic words and return dozens of unrelated results (live finding, NextCart session final_nc_1219732343: a 3-word product name query came back with 31 results). Query "mojari sandles" (typo) fuzzy-matches exactly ONE real catalog product (Leather Mojari Sandals) — server/store/index.js's searchCandidates('mojari sandles', ...) returns a single candidate — so the model should deep-link with cta.kind:"open_product" (value the real slug) instead of cta.kind:"search". Not independently checkable by replay.js's action/target matcher (it only checks action+target, not cta), so this fixture's PASS is necessary-but-not-sufficient; the cta.kind itself must be eyeballed in the trace/action log during a live run.
